event.name: DevFest Kisumu 2026
event.tagline: Building Resilient Tech Together by the Lake

speakers.name: Dr. Amina Ochieng
speakers.bio: Dr. Amina Ochieng leads applied machine learning research focused on low-resource East African languages, agricultural forecasting, and edge inference across mobile devices.

speakers.name: Brian Otieno
speakers.bio: Brian has spent 9 years architecting offline-first Android apps serving millions of mobile money users across Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania.

speakers.name: Wanjiku Mwangi
speakers.bio: Wanjiku specializes in web performance, Core Web Vitals, and Progressive Web Apps engineered for variable bandwidth networks across Africa.

speakers.name: Kevin Omondi
speakers.bio: Kevin helps high-growth startups design cost-effective, resilient Kubernetes and Cloud Run architectures on Google Cloud Platform.

speakers.name: Mercy Akinyi
speakers.bio: GDG Kisumu co-organizer and Flutter enthusiast passionate about accessible design systems, smooth 120fps animations, and mentoring new mobile engineers.

speakers.name: Samuel Kiprop
speakers.bio: Samuel builds production Gemini-powered workflows and RAG pipelines that deliver localized agronomy advice to smallholder farmers via SMS and web apps.

speakers.name: Faith Nyambura
speakers.bio: Faith champions inclusive tech communities, open-source contributions, and Women Techmakers initiatives across the Lake Victoria region.

speakers.name: Daniel Onyango
speakers.bio: Daniel designs event-driven APIs in Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL with a focus on observability, security, and zero-downtime deployments.

speakers.name: Zainab Hassan
speakers.bio: Zainab leads reliability engineering and OpenTelemetry instrumentation for real-time payment rails processing thousands of transactions per second.

speakers.name: George Wekesa
speakers.bio: George has helped grow the Kisumu developer ecosystem for over 6 years through hands-on study jams, hackathons, and student mentorship.

sessions.title: Registration, Swag Pickup & Lakeview Coffee
sessions.description: Check in at the Acacia Premier lobby, collect your DevFest Kisumu 2026 badge and swag kit, and connect with fellow builders over Kenyan coffee.

sessions.title: Welcome Remarks & GDG Kisumu 2026 Community Highlights
sessions.description: Kick off DevFest Kisumu 2026 with an overview of the day's tracks, community milestones across Nyanza and Western Kenya, and how to make the most of the event.

sessions.title: Opening Keynote: Practical AI Systems Built for Africa
sessions.description: Explore how engineers across East Africa are moving beyond demos to deploy reliable, multilingual, and low-latency AI applications using Gemini and on-device models.

sessions.title: Building Agentic Workflows with Gemini & Function Calling
sessions.description: A deep dive into structured outputs, tool calling, grounding, and evaluation patterns when shipping production AI agents for real-world customer workflows.

sessions.title: Offline-First Android Architecture with Compose & Room
sessions.description: Learn battle-tested synchronization patterns, WorkManager retries, and Jetpack Compose state management for apps that shine even on flaky 3G connections.

sessions.title: Sub-Second Web Apps: Mastering Core Web Vitals & Edge Caching
sessions.description: Practical profiling techniques to slash LCP, eliminate layout shifts, and optimize JavaScript bundles for mobile-first East African web audiences.

sessions.title: Hands-On Workshop: Shipping Resilient Node.js APIs to Cloud Run
sessions.description: Bring your laptop! Containerize an Express + Node.js service, configure health checks, secrets, autoscaling, and deploy a zero-downtime revision to Cloud Run.

sessions.title: Flutter in 2026: Impeller, Wasm & Adaptive UIs
sessions.description: See how Flutter's Impeller engine and WebAssembly compilation unlock buttery-smooth cross-platform apps across Android, iOS, and modern browsers.

sessions.title: Modern CSS & View Transitions Without Heavy Frameworks
sessions.description: Discover native CSS container queries, :has(), popover APIs, and smooth View Transitions that dramatically simplify frontend codebases.

sessions.title: Lunch Break & Community Booth Showcase
sessions.description: Enjoy lunch overlooking Lake Victoria while visiting local startup demos, Google Cloud study jam booths, and Women Techmakers networking tables.

sessions.title: On-Device Inference with Gemma & MediaPipe on Android
sessions.description: Run privacy-preserving small language models directly on mid-range smartphones, benchmark memory footprints, and build hybrid cloud-edge fallback flows.

sessions.title: Production Observability with OpenTelemetry & Cloud Trace
sessions.description: Stop guessing during 2 AM incidents. Instrument distributed microservices with traces, structured logs, and actionable SLO alerts.

sessions.title: Panel: Growing Your Engineering Career from Kisumu to Global Teams
sessions.description: Candid stories and practical advice on remote engineering roles, open-source portfolios, technical writing, and community leadership.

sessions.title: Securing Express & Node.js Backends Against Real-World Threats
sessions.description: Walk through rate limiting, schema validation, JWT pitfalls, dependency hygiene, and threat modeling tailored for fintech and civic tech APIs.

sessions.title: Lightning Talks: Built in Kisumu Demo Showcase
sessions.description: Five rapid-fire 7-minute demos from Lake Region developers showcasing civic tech tools, agri-tech bots, Flutter apps, and open-source packages.

sessions.title: Closing Keynote, Raffles & Group Photo
sessions.description: Wrap up DevFest Kisumu 2026 with community shoutouts, raffle prizes, upcoming GDG Kisumu study jams, and the iconic Lakeview group photo.
